location.user_summary: Allows accessing GPS or approximate cell/Wi-Fi locations.

contacts.user_summary: Allows reading or modifying your personal contacts list.

camera.user_summary: Allows taking photos and recording video.

microphone.user_summary: Allows recording ambient audio and voice.

phone.user_summary: Allows reading phone numbers, cellular state, or making calls.

sms.user_summary: Allows reading, receiving, or sending SMS/MMS messages.

call_logs.user_summary: Allows reading or writing personal telephone call logs.

calendar.user_summary: Allows accessing calendar events and personal schedules.

bluetooth_nearby.user_summary: Allows scanning for, connecting to, or advertising to nearby Bluetooth and Wi-Fi devices.

storage.user_summary: Allows reading or writing photos, videos, audio, or shared device files.

notifications.user_summary: Allows posting notifications or intercepting notification content.

biometrics.user_summary: Allows authenticating using fingerprint or face recognition hardware.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.description: Allows an app to access precise location from GPS and network sources.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.user_friendly_description: Can pinpoint your exact geographic location using GPS and Wi-Fi satellites.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.leak_implications: Precise real-time physical tracking and geofencing.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.description: Allows an app to access approximate location derived from network location sources.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.user_friendly_description: Can determine your general city or neighbourhood location.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.description: Allows an app to access location in the background.
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.user_friendly_description: Can track your location constantly, even when you are not actively using the app.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.description: Allows an application to read the user's contacts data.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.user_friendly_description: Can read the names, phone numbers, and emails of people in your address book.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.leak_implications: Harvesting personal social graph and address book records.

android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.description: Allows an application to write the user's contacts data.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.user_friendly_description: Can create, modify, or delete entries in your personal contacts list.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.leak_implications: Modification or injection of contact entries.

android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.description: Allows access to the list of accounts in the Accounts Service.
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.user_friendly_description: Can view accounts registered on your device (e.g. Google, email accounts).
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.leak_implications: Account username and email address discovery.

android.permission.CAMERA.description: Required to be able to access the camera device.
android.permission.CAMERA.user_friendly_description: Can take pictures and record video using your device camera.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.description: Allows an application to record audio.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.user_friendly_description: Can listen to and record sound through your device microphone.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.leak_implications: Audio surveillance and ambient voice eavesdropping.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.description: Allows read only access to phone state, including phone number and cellular network information.
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.user_friendly_description: Can access cellular carrier information and whether a call is in progress.
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.leak_implications: Carrier tracking and cellular network telemetry gathering.

android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE.description: Allows read access to privileged phone state (IMEI, MEID, IMSI).
android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE.user_friendly_description: Can read permanent hardware identifiers (IMEI, IMSI) that cannot be reset.

android.permission.CALL_PHONE.description: Allows an application to initiate a phone call without user confirmation.
android.permission.CALL_PHONE.user_friendly_description: Can place outgoing phone calls without opening the dialer screen.
android.permission.CALL_PHONE.leak_implications: Toll fraud or unintended call routing.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS.description: Allows read access to the device's phone numbers.
android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS.user_friendly_description: Can retrieve the telephone number associated with your SIM card.

android.permission.READ_SMS.description: Allows an application to read SMS messages.
android.permission.READ_SMS.user_friendly_description: Can read incoming and stored text messages, including two-factor verification codes (OTP).
android.permission.READ_SMS.leak_implications: 2FA code interception and private messaging exposure.

android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.description: Allows an application to receive SMS messages.
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.user_friendly_description: Can intercept incoming SMS messages as they arrive.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.description: Allows an application to send SMS messages.
android.permission.SEND_SMS.user_friendly_description: Can send text messages without opening the messenger app, potentially incurring charges.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.description: Allows an application to read the user's call log.
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.user_friendly_description: Can view your complete history of incoming, outgoing, and missed calls.
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.leak_implications: Caller history and communication frequency profiling.

android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.description: Allows an application to write the user's call log.
android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.user_friendly_description: Can modify or erase call history records on your phone.

android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.description: Allows an application to read the user's calendar data.
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.user_friendly_description: Can read your personal appointments, meeting details, and schedules.

android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.description: Allows an application to write the user's calendar data.
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.user_friendly_description: Can add or edit entries in your personal calendar.
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.leak_implications: Calendar tampering or spam event injection.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH.description: Allows applications to connect to paired bluetooth devices.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH.user_friendly_description: Can communicate with devices you have already paired via Bluetooth.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.description: Required to be able to discover and pair nearby Bluetooth devices.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.user_friendly_description: Can search for nearby Bluetooth devices (which can also indicate physical location).
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.leak_implications: Beacon proximity tracking and physical presence detection.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.description: Required to be able to connect to paired Bluetooth devices.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.user_friendly_description: Can connect to Bluetooth accessories such as headphones or smartwatches.

android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES.description: Required to be able to advertise and connect to nearby Wi-Fi devices.
android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES.user_friendly_description: Can scan for nearby Wi-Fi devices without needing fine location permission.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.description: Allows an application to read from external storage.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.user_friendly_description: Can access documents, downloaded files, and photos stored on your device.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.leak_implications: Unrestricted file access and document harvesting.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.description: Allows an application to write to external storage.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.user_friendly_description: Can create, alter, or delete files stored in device shared storage.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.leak_implications: Shared storage alteration and data caching.

android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.description: Allows an application a broad access to external storage in all-files access.
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.user_friendly_description: Has full access to manage and modify every file on your device storage.
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.leak_implications: Broad filesystem harvesting and complete data access.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.description: Allows an application to read image files from external storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.user_friendly_description: Can view and inspect all photos stored on your device.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.leak_implications: Personal photography and EXIF location metadata exposure.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.description: Allows an application to read video files from external storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.user_friendly_description: Can view all recorded videos stored on your device.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.description: Allows an application to read audio files from external storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.user_friendly_description: Can read audio recordings and music files stored on your device.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.leak_implications: Voice memos and audio file access.

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Allows an app to post notifications.
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.user_friendly_description: Can show notifications and alerts in your system tray.

android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LIS.description: Must be required by an NotificationListenerService, to ensure that only the system can bind to it.
android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LIS.user_friendly_description: Can read the text of all notifications generated by any app on your phone.
android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LIS.leak_implications: Cross-application notification interception (reading chats, codes, alerts).

android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.description: Allows an app to use device supported biometric modalities.
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.user_friendly_description: Can request user authentication via fingerprint or facial recognition.

android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT.description: This constant was deprecated in API level 28. Applications should use USE_BIOMETRIC instead.
android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT.user_friendly_description: Can prompt for fingerprint verification (legacy Android API).

android.permission.INTERNET.description: Allows applications to open network sockets.
android.permission.INTERNET.user_friendly_description: Allows connecting to the internet and remote web servers.
android.permission.INTERNET.leak_implications: Primary transport vector for transmitting collected data off-device.

android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.description: Allows applications to access information about networks.
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.user_friendly_description: Can check if the device is connected to Wi-Fi or cellular data.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.description: Allows using PowerManager WakeLocks to keep processor from sleeping.
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.user_friendly_description: Prevents your device screen or processor from going to sleep.

android.permission.VIBRATE.user_friendly_description: Can activate the device vibration motor for haptic feedback.

android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.description: Allows an application to receive the Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.user_friendly_description: Can start automatically as soon as your phone finishes turning on.
